title: A proposed strategy for enhancing collaboration between schools and their local communities
core_idea: Develop a vision and guiding philosophy for partnerships between schools and their local communities by examining what community partnerships involve, their aims, and how they can be implemented effectively to support continuous improvement in education by building on strengths and addressing weaknesses.
tldr: Proposes a guiding vision and implementation framework for effective school–community partnerships aimed at sustaining and improving education over time.
